svg.title: Column chart of modelled monthly revenue in US dollars at each growth stage, from 500 to 2,000,000 merchants, on a logarithmic scale. It is an assumption-based model, not a forecast, and each column's value is written above it.

text.font-family: 'Montserrat', 'Noto Kufi Arabic', 'Noto Sans Hebrew', 'Noto Sans Devanagari', 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif
